lines.beaver: 야, 나 어제 또 지갑 잃어버렸어.
lines.beaver_en: Hey, I lost my wallet again yesterday.
lines.beaver_roman: Ya, na eoje tto jigap ireobeoryeosseo.
lines.learner: 너 또 덜렁댔구나. 그 습관 고쳐야 해.
lines.en: You were careless again. You need to fix that habit.
lines.roman: Neo tto deolleongdaetguna. Geu seupgwan gochyeoya hae.

lines.beaver: 그것뿐이 아니야. 나보고 말도 많다고들 해.
lines.beaver_en: That is not all. People say I talk too much, too.
lines.beaver_roman: geugeotppuni aniya. nabogo maldo mantagodeul hae.
lines.learner: 응, 좀 수다스럽긴 해. 남 말도 들어 봐.
lines.en: Yeah, you are a bit talkative. Listen to others too.
lines.roman: Eung, jom sudaseureopgin hae. Nam maldo deureo bwa.

lines.beaver: 어제 회의 때도 내가 호들갑 떨었어.
lines.beaver_en: I made a fuss at the meeting yesterday, too.
lines.beaver_roman: Eoje hoeui ttaedo naega hodeulgap tteoreosseo.
lines.en: That's exactly when you should keep your composure.

lines.beaver_en: And I insisted unreasonably in front of my boss.
lines.learner: 억지 부려 봤자 아무 소용 없어.
lines.roman: Eokji buryeo bwatja amu soyong eopseo.

lines.learner: 가끔 이기심이 보여. 융통성도 좀 키워.
lines.en: Sometimes I see selfishness. Be more flexible, too.
lines.roman: Gakkeum igisimi boyeo. Yungtongseongdo jom kiwo.

lines.beaver: 너 오늘 좀 짓궂다. 일부러 놀리는 거지?
lines.beaver_en: You're mischievous today. Teasing me on purpose?
lines.beaver_roman: Neo oneul jom jitgutda. Ilbureo nollineun geoji?
lines.learner: 아니, 진심이야. 돌려 말하기 싫어서 그래.
lines.en: No, I mean it. I just don't want to beat around the bush.
lines.roman: Ani, jinsimiya. Dollyeo malhagi sileoseo geurae.

lines.beaver: 사실 일 좀 한다고 자만했나 봐.
lines.beaver_en: Honestly, I guess I got conceited about my work.
lines.beaver_roman: Sasil il jom handago jamanhaenna bwa.
lines.learner: 응, 자만하지 말고 전문가 행세도 그만해.
lines.en: Yeah, drop the conceit and stop acting like an expert.
lines.roman: Eung, jamanhaji malgo jeonmunga haengsedo geumanhae.

lines.beaver_en: I want to change, but I'm too weak.
lines.learner: 나약하다고 포기해 봤자 달라지는 건 없어.
lines.en: Giving up because you're weak won't change anything.
lines.roman: Nayakadago pogihae bwatja dallajineun geon eopseo.

lines.beaver: 기분 따라 자꾸 바뀌는 것도 문제지?
lines.beaver_en: Changing with my moods is a problem too, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Gibun ttara jakku bakkwineun geotdo munjeji?
lines.learner: 응, 그 변덕만 줄여도 훨씬 나아질 거야.
lines.en: Yeah, just cutting that fickleness will help a lot.
lines.roman: Eung, geu byeondeongman juryeodo hwolssin naajil geoya.

lines.beaver: 고마워. 매번 잔소리 듣게 해서 미안해.
lines.beaver_en: Thanks. Sorry for making you lecture me every time.
lines.beaver_roman: Gomawo. Maebeon jansori deutge haeseo mianhae.
lines.learner: 미안하긴 뭘. 친구 좋다는 게 뭐야.
lines.en: Nothing to be sorry about. That's what friends are for.
lines.roman: Mianhagin mwol. Chingu jotaneun ge mwoya.
